mapper.select: select s.name as supplier_name, s.email, s.phone_number, s.postal_code, s.prefecture, s.city, s.street_address, s.building_name, pt.payment_term_id, pt.name as paymentTermName, s.is_active as active from supplier s left join payment_term pt on s.payment_term_id = pt.payment_term_id where supplier_id = #{supplierId};
mapper.update: update supplier set name = #{name}, email = #{email}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, postal_code = #{postalCode}, prefecture = #{prefecture}, city = #{city}, street_address = #{streetAddress}, building_name = #{buildingName}, payment_term_id = #{paymentTermId}, is_active = #{isActive} where supplier_id = #{supplierId}
mapper.select: select supplier_id, name from supplier order by name asc;
